Kimberly / Marissa —

Reviewed the Order Form and attached publicity language. High-level guidance and proposed redlines below: please treat as internal counsel draft.

1) Publicity / Reference Rights
- Proposed concession: allow NovaWorks to publish a case spotlight that includes a short, pre-approved quote from Redwood (<= 2 sentences).
- Approval process: Redwood marketing to provide quote; NovaWorks has 5 business days to request edits; if no response, quote is deemed approved.
- Trademark/logo use: grant limited, revocable license to reproduce Redwood’s logo for the specific press kit and landing page only. Explicitly prohibit use in third-party paid advertising or co-branded commercial materials without prior written consent.

2) Confidentiality / Embargo
- Recommend adding a 30-day mutual embargo option after publication for reference/notable-customer lists (so neither party publishes lists of launch customers for 30 days unless mutually agreed).
- For any references to unreleased features, require express written consent from Redwood’s product lead.

3) Order Form execution and evidence
- We require an executed Order Form (DocuSign) before Redwood’s quote appears in public.
- Request SOC2 report and a standard security attestation as part of procurement intake (can be redacted).

4) Draft language (to insert into publicity clause):
"Subject to Customer approval as set forth herein, Customer may publish case studies or press materials referencing Redwood Inference and may reproduce Redwood’s trademark and logo solely in connection with such materials. Use of Redwood trademarks in paid advertising or third-party promotional campaigns requires prior written approval from Redwood. Quotes must be provided to Redwood for review at least five (5) business days prior to publication and are deemed approved if no edit request is received within such period. References to unreleased product features are prohibited without prior written consent"

I attached an annotated redline (Redline_MSA_confidentiality_KI.docx). If NovaWorks pushes back on the 30-day embargo, we could offer a shorter 14-day window as a compromise.

Let me know if you want us to send the redline directly to NovaWorks legal or if we should route through the sales contact.

—Karthik
